Embedding request via Google Vertex AI using the vertex_ai/ provider prefix and the text-embedding-005 model — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"input\":\"Hello\",\"model\":\"vertex_ai/text-embedding-005\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, EmbeddingRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.embed(req);
        System.out.println(result.data());
        System.out.println(result.data().get(0).embedding());
        }
    }
}
```
